items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: The interviewee does not respond to the interviewer's claim that Alfred Lane was with Durante; the interviewer states 'He was with Durante, my son.' The interviewee's subsequent 'He wouldn't have...' appears to be a correction or continuation regarding Alfred Lane's actions, not an acknowledgment of

ctx.x: A couple of them did. Now, what I've learned was through Perkins. You know how I learned in the notes, it was through Perkins. See? Yeah. He'd teach me and show me just what to do and where to make my stops, where I make rows, where I have to beat before rows and so on. See? Well, then I got onto all of that very quick.

That's the same year that Alfred went to New York. He played. He was with Durante, my son. That's right. He was with Durante. Yes, sir. We got Durante's card. His wife, he never fails sending him a Christmas card every year. And when he died, he sent him a beautiful card. Jimmy Durante? Yes. Fact. Yes.
